'''Exploding mushrooms''' were large and volatile [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] that could explode when touched.

==Behind the scenes==
The mushroom was first seen in the [[1991]] video game [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (1991 video game)|''The Empire Strikes Back'']], and was named in the game's manual.
